title: CheckoutHex
body: CheckoutHex is the directory name for a checkout under ~/.archivist/checkouts.

title: StorePath
body: StorePath is the one archive database, ~/.archivist/archive.db.

title: ResolvedBaseURL
body: ResolvedBaseURL is ollama.base_url, else $OLLAMA_HOST, else localhost.

title: OpenReadOnly
body: OpenReadOnly opens an existing database for reads. It does not create the file, parent directories, schema, or orphan cleanup.

title: Canonical
body: Canonical returns path as a cleaned absolute path with symlinks resolved.

title: FileVectorHash
body: FileVectorHash is the text hash stored with this file's vector.

title: Package config
body: Package config loads and saves ~/.archivist/config.json.

title: Package archive
body: Package archive creates, updates, retires, and imports records.

title: Chat excerpt
body: User: the tests failed. Assistant: I will rerun go test and paste the log here.

title: Turn log
body: User: can you see the error? Assistant: yes, the stack trace is in the last message.

title: Session paste
body: Human: try again. Agent: running the same command now. Human: still broken.

title: Tool chatter
body: Assistant: I called search. User: what did it return? Assistant: three hits, none of them the topic.

title: Back and forth
body: User: stop. Assistant: stopping. User: no, continue the last command.

title: Quoted thread
body: User said the build was red. The assistant replied that it would look at the compiler output next.

title: Conversation scrap
body: User: hello. Assistant: hello. User: ignore that, the real question is below.

title: Dialogue dump
body: A: did you push? B: not yet. A: leave it. B: ok.

title: MCP down
body: This chat's error: MCP is down, so the tool call failed once.

title: Port closed
body: curl to localhost:11434 failed with connection refused during this session.

title: One test flake
body: go test ./internal/cmd failed once on a timeout and passed on the next run.

title: Missing binary
body: The shell said archivist: command not found in this terminal.

title: Edit rejected
body: The apply failed because the file changed under the editor in this turn.

title: Auth blip
body: The registry returned 401 once. The next install succeeded.

title: Disk full
body: The build stopped because the temp dir filled up on this machine today.

title: Stale socket
body: The language server socket was stale and the window reloaded.

title: Unverified model list
body: A blog lists twelve local models and their sizes. None of those claims were checked.

title: Package roundup
body: An unread catalog of CLI tools with star counts copied from a web page.

title: Benchmark table
body: A pasted table of accuracy numbers from a vendor page, not measured here.

title: Library index
body: Names of embedding models gathered from a search page, with no local run.

title: Option dump
body: A list of config keys copied from upstream docs and not tried in this checkout.

title: Release notes scrape
body: Third-party release notes collected into a list. Versions were not confirmed.

title: Shortcut sheet
body: A directory of shell aliases from a gist, not the commands this repo runs.

title: Paper list
body: Titles of papers about retrieval, with no note on which ones this project uses.

title: Same decision again
body: Restating the existing decision: SQLite is the source of truth for records.

title: Repeat the rule
body: Again: if unsure whether a later session would look it up, write the record.

title: Feature echo
body: This repeats the hybrid search feature: FTS and cosine, keyword-only when Ollama is down.

title: Review echo
body: Restatement: review lists evidence and does not rank records.

title: Embed echo
body: Saying again that embeddings go through Ollama and the model name is qwen3-embedding.

title: Scope echo
body: Repeating the scope procedure: dev, repo, or global, and search has no scope filter.

title: Link echo
body: Restating that record links live in the checkout database and a checkout does not link to itself.

title: Prompt echo
body: The same sentence as the add-decision prompt: a decision is a choice among real alternatives.
